name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he excelled in mechanical engineering. His involvement in the university's Formula Student team honed his technical skills and fueled his ambition to work in the racing industry. After graduation, Li joined a local automotive company, quickly demonstrating his aptitude for problem-solving and innovation. He transitioned to karting after a chance encounter with a Kosmic Kart engineer at a regional race. 

Li's approach as Technical Director is rooted in data-driven analysis and a commitment to continuous improvement. He believes in empowering his team to explore creative solutions, fostering a collaborative environment where every member's input is valued. His calm demeanor and ability to think strategically under pressure make him a valuable asset to Kosmic Kart, particularly during high-stakes races. He is known for his ability to quickly identify and address mechanical issues, ensuring the kart's optimal performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Li is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and race notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his chin when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of green tea during race weekends for good luck.
